overclaims: Niantic deployed Llama 2 in Peridot in November 2023.
checks.note: e2 says only that Niantic 'initially integrated' Llama 2 into Peridot in November 2023. The packet notes the customer's own announcement said release was still forthcoming. The case study shows players later used the feature, since it cites positive feedback from the gaming community, but it does not date that release to November 2023. Fix: say 'integrated Llama 2 into Peridot in November 2023, and it was later released to players.' Axis, outcome, horizon, excerpt, conditions and citations are otherwise fine.
